clone_tools.name: remote_read_file
clone_tools.description: Read from a known remote SSH host. Use this instead of read_file plus an invented host argument or ssh/cat through exec/bash.

clone_tools.name: remote_read_files
clone_tools.description: Read multiple files from a known remote SSH host in one operation.

clone_tools.name: remote_write_file
clone_tools.description: Write a complete file on a known remote SSH host.

clone_tools.name: remote_edit_file
clone_tools.description: Apply structured edits to one file on a known remote SSH host.

clone_tools.name: remote_edit_files
clone_tools.description: Apply structured edits to multiple files on a known remote SSH host.

clone_tools.name: remote_file_info
clone_tools.description: Return metadata for a filesystem path on a known remote SSH host.

clone_tools.name: remote_list_directory
clone_tools.description: List a directory on a known remote SSH host without shell quoting.

clone_tools.name: remote_create_directory
clone_tools.description: Create a directory on a known remote SSH host.

clone_tools.name: remote_move_file
clone_tools.description: Move or rename a path on a known remote SSH host without shell quoting.

clone_tools.name: remote_search_start
clone_tools.description: Start a bounded file or content search on a known remote SSH host. The returned search_id is an opaque handle used by remote_search_results and remote_search_stop.

clone_tools.name: remote_exec
clone_tools.description: Execute argv directly on a known remote SSH host without asking the assistant to construct a quoted ssh command.

clone_tools.name: remote_bash
clone_tools.description: Run intentional shell syntax on a known remote SSH host. Prefer remote_exec when shell syntax is not required.

clone_tools.name: remote_process_start
clone_tools.description: Start a durable process on a known remote SSH host. The returned process_id is an opaque handle used by remote_process_output, remote_process_input, and remote_process_signal.

clone_tools.name: remote_process_output
clone_tools.description: Read output from an opaque process handle returned by remote_process_start.

clone_tools.name: remote_process_input
clone_tools.description: Write stdin to an opaque interactive process handle returned by remote_process_start.

clone_tools.name: remote_process_signal
clone_tools.description: Send a signal to an opaque process handle returned by remote_process_start.

clone_tools.name: remote_process_list
clone_tools.description: List or recover durable processes for a known remote SSH host, including after an uncertain remote_process_start acknowledgement.

clone_tools.name: remote_search_results
clone_tools.description: Read results from an opaque search handle returned by remote_search_start.

clone_tools.name: remote_search_stop
clone_tools.description: Stop an opaque search handle returned by remote_search_start.

clone_tools.name: remote_search_list
clone_tools.description: List active search sessions for a known remote SSH host.
